What We Do

Four jobs. One mission.

Building durable political power for LGBTQ+ equality in Ohio.

Endorse Candidates

We identify, vet, and back pro-equality candidates from school board to statewide office, then put real resources behind them.

See Endorsements →

Score Every Legislator

All 132 members of the General Assembly, graded on floor votes, committee votes, and bill sponsorships. No exceptions.

View the Scorecard →

Fight Anti-LGBTQ+ Bills

We track every anti-equality bill moving in the Statehouse and organize testimony, calls, and pressure to stop them.

Track the Bills →

Mobilize Voters

We register, educate, and turn out pro-equality voters in every corner of the state, from Cincinnati to Conneaut.

Volunteer →
Know Where They Stand

Every legislator. Every vote. On the record.

Our scorecard grades all 132 members of the Ohio General Assembly on their LGBTQ+ equality record: floor votes, committee votes, and bill sponsorships. Find your state senator and representative, see their grade, and share it with your community.

A+ Champion A Strong Ally A- Reliable Ally B Supportive C Mixed Record D Unfriendly F Hostile

November 3, 2026 · Ohio Votes for Governor

Acton and Ramaswamy, side by side.

The next governor signs or vetoes every equality bill that reaches the desk. Our guide puts both records on one page — every line dated, sourced, and linked. No grades, no endorsement, and where a candidate has taken no position, we say so.
